explication: RHI is a Windows game-library manager for installing and maintaining HDR mods, ReShade, upscalers, shader packs, frame limiters, and NVIDIA settings. The main user flow is discover or add games, view per-game controls, then install or configure components in game folders; background update orchestration maintains them afterward. Groups and paths reflect the supplied tree and README. Several service implementations were not sampled, so their internal call wiring is intentionally left out.
